'''Fedalle''' was a powerful and wealthy [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] [[Factory world/Legends|industrial planet]] located on the [[Hydian Way/Legends|Hydian Way]]. It was home to a population known as the [[Fedallean]]s. Located in [[Realspace/Legends|space]] explored between [[27,500 BBY]] and [[25,000 BBY/Legends|25,000 BBY]], Fedalle had become a part of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] by around [[22,000 BBY/Legends|22,000 BBY]] and was aligned with the Republic's [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|world]], [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], during the early [[Alsakan Conflicts/Legends|Alsakan Conflicts]]. By the time of the [[Mandalorian Wars]], Fedalle had been visited by the Republic [[Hammerhead-class cruiser|''Hammerhead''-class cruiser]] [[Sanctuary (starship)|''Sanctuary'']]. [[Millennium/Legends|Millennia]] later, the planet was a part of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], eventually serving as an Imperial [[Fortress world/Legends|fortress world]]. By [[11 ABY/Legends|11 ABY]], Fedalle was represented in the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] by [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Hrekin Thorm]].

==Description==
Fedalle was a terrestrial<ref name="Lessons" /> [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|I|258|Fedalle}}</ref> located in the [[Fedalle system/Legends|Fedalle system]]. It was a part of the [[Arrowhead]], or [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]. By approximately [[22,000 BBY/Legends|22,000 BBY]], Fedalle was situated between the [[Glithnos system/Legends|Glithnos]] and [[Talravin system/Legends|Talravin systems]] on the [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperspace route]] known as the [[Brentaal–Denon Route]]. At some point following [[3694 BBY]], the hyperlane was integrated into the [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]-spanning [[Hydian Way/Legends|Hydian Way]] [[Super-hyperroute/Legends|super-hyperroute]]. Another [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] route also linked Fedalle to the [[Raxxa system/Legends|Raxxa system]].<ref name="TEA Fedalle" /> Between approximately [[17,000 BBY]] and [[11,000 BBY]], that route connected it to the [[Xorth system/Legends|Xorth system]], as well.<ref name="EGTW" />

==History==
===An ancient Core World===
[[File:SanctuaryWreckage-FDCR.png|thumb|right|300px|The ''Sanctuary'' (wreckage pictured) once visited Fedalle.]]
[[Realspace/Legends|Space]] surrounding Fedalle was explored between [[27,500 BBY]] and [[25,000 BBY/Legends|25,000 BBY]], and the planet had become a part of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] by around 22,000 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]].<ref name="TEA Fedalle" /> During the early [[Alsakan Conflicts/Legends|Alsakan Conflicts]], a series of wars that began in [[17,018 BBY]] and saw the Republic's [[Capital/Legends|capital]] world [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], the planet [[Alsakan/Legends|Alsakan]], and their respective allies struggle over [[Politics/Legends|political]] and economic control over the Republic, Fedalle was affiliated with Coruscant.<ref name="EGTW" /> The world was at one point visited by the Republic [[Hammerhead-class cruiser|''Hammerhead''-class cruiser]] [[Sanctuary (starship)|''Sanctuary'']]&mdash;which was active by the time of the [[Mandalorian Wars]]<ref name="Lessons" /> of [[3976 BBY]]&ndash;[[3960 BBY]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>&mdash;with the visit being noted on the [[Cruiser/Legends|starship's]] flight record.<ref name="Lessons" />

[[Millennium/Legends|Millennia]] later, a [[Standard century/Legends|century]] prior to the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] that was fought between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]<ref name="Lessons" /> in [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]]&ndash;[[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]],<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Unidentified Astral Jester captain|captain]] of the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] ''[[Astral Jester]]'', hoping to lay a claim on a hyperlane leading through the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]], filed dozens of well-documented yet erroneous flight plans, including one detailing a route from Coruscant to Fedalle.<ref name="Lessons" /> Later, the [[Fourth Outer Rim Army|Fourth Army]] of the Republic's [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army]] was tasked with engaging the [[Confederacy military/Legends|military forces]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] in Fedalle's vicinity as part of the first campaigns of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].<ref name="EGTW" />

===After the Republic===
[[17 BBY/Legends|Five years]] later, Fedalle had been incorporated into the territory of the Empire.<ref name="EGTW" /> Under that regime, the planet was represented in the [[Imperial Senate/Legends|Imperial Senate]] by its [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] [[Hrekin Thorm]].<ref name="JAS" /> By the time of the Galactic Civil War, both the flight record of the ''Sanctuary'' and the ''Astral Jester'' flight plan mentioning Fedalle had come to rest in the [[Phelar University Archive|Archive]] of [[Phelar University]] on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] planet [[Eriadu/Legends|Eriadu]].<ref name="Lessons" />

{{RPG|"[[Lessons from the Past]]"}}
At one point during that conflict, a group of [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] individuals performing research in the Archive discovered both of the documents containing mentions of Fedalle.<ref name="Lessons" />
{{Endgame}}

Fedalle served as an Imperial [[Fortress world/Legends|fortress world]] between 4 ABY and [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]].<ref name="TEA Fedalle" /> By [[11 ABY/Legends|11 ABY]],<ref name="11 ABY">''[[The Jedi Academy Sourcebook]]'' establishes that [[Hrekin Thorm]] served in the [[New Republic Senate/Legends|New Republic Senate]] by the time of the events of the ''[[Star Wars: The Jedi Academy Trilogy]]'', the events of which ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates to [[11 ABY/Legends|11 ABY]].</ref> Thorm represented Fedalle as a [[Senator/Legends|senator]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. Owing to Fedalle's influence in the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]], he had a powerful role in the [[New Republic Senate/Legends|Senate]] as well as the political backing to get himself to be appointed to the New Republic's [[Inner Council (New Republic)|Inner Council]].<ref name="JAS" />

==Inhabitants==
Fedalle was an affluent and powerful<ref name="JAS" /> [[Factory world/Legends|industrial world]].<ref name="Lessons" /> It was home to the population known as the [[Fedallean]]s, who generally espoused a pragmatic yet self-centered philosophy of being largely indifferent to what political faction served as the galactic government as long as the interests of Fedalle were served.<ref name="JAS" />

==Behind the scenes==
Fedalle was first mentioned in ''[[The Jedi Academy Sourcebook]]'', which was written by [[Paul Sudlow]] and published in [[1996]] by [[West End Games]] for use with ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="JAS" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Fedalle [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore the planet itself, in grid square M-10.<ref name="TEA Fedalle" /> In "[[Lessons from the Past]]," a [[Star Wars Roleplaying|roleplaying]] adventure included in the [[2015]] [[Star Wars: Force and Destiny Core Rulebook|Core Rulebook]] for [[Fantasy Flight Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: Force and Destiny]]'' [[roleplaying game]] system, the player characters can optionally discover pieces of information mentioning Fedalle. This article assumes the scenario plays out as described.<ref name="Lessons" />
